name: LinerBot
description: Web crawler operated by Liner, an AI search and research assistant. It builds and refreshes the index behind Liner's search and reference features — paper metadata, citations and DOI resolution — so Liner's agents can retrieve and cite pages. Liner's crawler page documents the user agent and robots.txt token, gives worked examples for a full disallow and for path-scoped rules, and states that rules naming LinerBot do not apply to its on-demand sibling Liner-User. Both agents sign their requests with HTTP Message Signatures under separate keys; Liner publishes no address ranges for either.

instances: Mozilla/5.0 AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko; compatible; LinerBot/1.0; +https://liner-bot.liner.com/docs/liner-bot)
